_note: Per-cockpit seat offsets (root local space) for Modern Muscle. DriverSeatServer reads DriverSeatOffsetX/Y/Z and VehicleBuildService.addPassengerSeat reads PassengerSeatOffsetX/Y/Z; the seat part (2.2 x 0.45 x 2.2) is placed with its centre at root.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset). Every Muscle cockpit has an explicit override below. They are GENERATED from the spec geometry, NOT measured in Play (the status the Exotic mesh cars had before their Play test).

rule._rootPartCentreAboveSeatTop: Only used for a cockpit without an override (none today). The Muscle driver dummy is a small torso high in the cabin, so this rule alone would put heads through the roofs: keep the overrides.

pilotAcceptance._decision: pending | measured | overrides. overrides: no measurement is used; every cockpit in scope has explicit values in overrides.
pilotAcceptance.note: Generated, not measured. Seated R15 figure used: HumanoidRootPart centre 1.5 above the seat top (seat centre Y + 0.225 + 1.5), head top 2.2 above the root part centre, feet about 2.25 below it. So head top = seat Y + 3.925 and feet = seat Y - 0.525. X = the dummy torso X (-2.0 on all six), passenger mirrored. Z = the dummy torso Z. Y = the lower of (a) the dummy rule, torso centre Y - 1.725, and (b) roof underside - 0.2 - 3.925, so the head stays at least 0.2 under the roof. Floor = the tub floor top, Y 0.3. Run stage_b/measure_seat.lua in Play on each car and correct the numbers here (a data-only change; rebuild afterwards).

perCockpit.muscle_01: Notch: roof underside Y 5.3 (roof panel 5.45 centre, 0.3 thick). Dummy rule 2.075 would put the head top at 6.0. Y = 5.3 - 0.2 - 3.925 = 1.175. Head top 5.1, feet 0.65 (above the floor).
perCockpit.muscle_02: Ute: roof underside Y 5.7. Y = 1.575. Head top 5.5, feet 1.05.
perCockpit.muscle_03: Ragtop: open cockpit, no roof. Y = dummy torso 3.12 - 1.725 = 1.395. Head top 5.32, just under the windscreen header (5.5). The cabin floor of this car is at Y 2.62, so the hips sit about 0.5 into the floor panel; the body sides hide it.
perCockpit.muscle_04: Hardtop: roof underside Y 5.7. Y = 1.575. Head top 5.5, feet 1.05.
perCockpit.muscle_05: Fastback: roof underside Y 5.6. Y = 1.475. Head top 5.4, feet 0.95.
perCockpit.muscle_06: Modern: low roof, underside Y 4.75. Y = 0.625. Head top 4.55. Feet 0.1: 0.2 below the tub floor top (0.3), inside the floor slab (underside -0.4). Both rules cannot hold here; the head under the roof wins.

pilotAcceptance.placeholderCabins: The placeholder cabins are solid blocks (a body block from Y 0.3 to 3.3 and glass blocks above it), so a seated avatar is inside them whatever the height. The values above set the head height; legs and torso will clip until the real models come.

_overrides: Per cockpit: {"driver": [x, y, z], "passenger": [x, y, z]} (seat centre, root local space, each number within +-40). An override replaces the derived values for that cockpit.
